title: DesignEvo: Recovering and Tracking Repository-Level Implemented Design Systems Across Commits
abstract: arXiv:2611.32020v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern frontend applications rely on design systems to maintain consistency across pages and releases. However, documentation and component libraries do not fully capture how interface patterns are implemented, reused, and adapted in practice. Existing UI analysis techniques focus on visual defects, interface structure, or element correspondences, providing limited support for automatically recovering and tracking implemented design systems at the repository level. To bridge this gap, we present DesignEvo, which combines screenshots, DOM structure, element geometry, and style values to recover functional UI groups. DesignEvo constrains vision-language model judgments to program-generated candidate regions, aggregates recovered groups and styles into repository-level records, and infers lifecycle states across adjacent commits. translated_title: DesignEvo：跨提交恢复与追踪仓库级已实现的设计系统
translated_abstract: 现代前端应用依赖设计系统来保持页面和发布版本之间的一致性。然而，文档和组件库并不能完整捕捉界面模式在实践中是如何被实现、复用和调整的。现有的UI分析技术主要关注视觉缺陷、界面结构或元素对应关系，对在仓库级别自动恢复和追踪已实现的设计系统提供的支持有限。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了DesignEvo，它结合截图、DOM结构、元素几何信息和样式值来恢复功能性UI组。DesignEvo将视觉-语言模型的判断约束在程序生成的候选区域内，将恢复的UI组和样式聚合为仓库级记录，并在相邻提交之间推断其生命周期状态。我们在包含317个页面-版本实例和3,478个标注功能的10个开源仓库上对DesignEvo进行了评估。
tldr: DesignEvo通过融合截图、DOM结构、元素几何与样式信息，并将视觉-语言模型判断约束在程序生成的候选区域内，实现了跨提交在仓库级别自动恢复与追踪已实现的设计系统及其生命周期状态。
en_tdlr: DesignEvo recovers and tracks repository-level implemented design systems across commits by combining screenshots, DOM structure, element geometry, and style values, while constraining vision-language model judgments to program-generated candidate regions.
